answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, forfeited on duplicate submission, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The signal lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the delta is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Reaching the jetty of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
